LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADVERBS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.3: Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 9.3.1 WORD CLASS: ADVERBS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 9.3.1 Word Class: Adverbs important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we describe when, how, where and how many times an action takes place?
2. Which word or words do we use to ask questions?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify adverbs of manner, time, place and frequency in a text
2. use adverbs correctly in oral and written contexts
3. use the modals could and would and the phrase how many...could/would in sentences correctly

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
